title: Pre-outcome action-history observer evaluation on frozen PPO
simulator: ManiSkill PhysX CPU, official task flags, one policy per task, 50 steps each
primary_question: Does an action-only, acknowledgement-gated target observer reproduce actual target-memory conditioned transfer without reading _target_pose or get_state during decision making?
exactness_definition: Projected non-exact actions do not represent the exact policy physical target; do not report as equivalent or safe.
observer_condition: Per episode reset from achieved end-effector pose, then forward integrate each acknowledged target-native command using documented root aligned target delta semantics.
refusal_condition: Action outside normalized representable set, unsupported controller ABI, stale ACK, in-flight ambiguity, unknown delivery or missing reset: fail closed, do not silently extrapolate.
audit_condition: After entire trajectory is finished, compare reconstructed and live target pose; position max error <= 3e-5 m and SO(3) relative angle <= 3e-4 rad; fail on breach.
primary_outcomes: per-seed official success flags for observer vs live-memory vs state-blind
predeclared_interpretation: Equivalence of observer and live memory, if seen, establishes an implementation-specific controller recurrence reconstruction, not generalization or top-conference novelty. If not seen, preserve all failures and do not tune seeds.
risk: Unknown controller-side clipping, altered state semantics or delayed action consumption can invalidate reconstruction. The controller-side state getter is used for endpoint audit only, after the complete closed-loop trial.
scope_limitations: one public frozen PPO each for two tasks
owner-run simulation, not independent outside validation
no robotics safety certification or real robot claim
